notes: Posted 29 July 2001 with no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

The title and post say the deck took 2nd place at the (San Diego) ComiCon Open; the strategy says he lost to Girard's Watch Your Phil deck there by 32. Paul Myers' post 18196 says Matt Berta took a version about 10 cards different to 2nd place at ComicCon.

Starting cards as posted under 'Start (9 cards on table)': Hunt Down, Meditation Chamber, Holotheatre, Visage Of The Emperor, Epic Duel, Podrace Arena, Sebulba's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace and an Effect; these count toward the 60. The strategy says he almost always starts Watto's Box (Secret Plans against a WYS podrace deck that will win the race), so Watto's Box is shown as the starting effect. Start Your Engines! (in the list) is the starting interrupt that deploys Podrace Arena, a Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace and the Effect.

Posted 'Hunt Down And Destroy Their Podracer/The Fire Can Be Seen From Mos Espa' is a joke name for Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe; 'Sebulba's, of course' (the one Podracer) dested Sebulba's Podracer.
Boonta Eve Podrace and Tatooine: Podrace Arena dested to their Dark pages (deployed by Start Your Engines!).

Posted 'EPP Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'DVDLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Darth Maul' the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Death Star' the A New Hope Dark system.
Secret Plans, No Escape and the other Effects are Effects, not Defensive Shields, in 2001.
The strategy's 9 August update swaps Death Star for the Cantina; the list is kept as published.
player_note: The post says the list was updated after the event: it was tweaked to include the best parts of Paul Myers' version and the U-3PO spy was added, so it may differ from what was played at Comic-Con.
